additional_info.subject: ID0433033-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313483122003]- Logs check CRM:02919000014
additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Yes, there was in fact a charging session attempt at this hour. Please mind that the logs show in UTC time, so it's -2h from your region.
As you can see, at 07:10:15, the customer tried to charge but did not provide any authentication, as such, we aborted the session. What we usually see is a log "Tag scanned" which means that a RFID was presented or "Credit card" and I see neither of those here.
Let me know your thoughts and questions before I close the ticket.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
